did: Home now holds a connection open to the mailbox's bell, so a routine's file reaches home within seconds of its put, and what home files goes out as soon as it is kept, instead of waiting up to fifteen minutes. The timer poll stays as a backstop: hourly while the bell is held, every fifteen minutes while it is not, and a reconnect's catch-up waits its turn, so a flapping bell costs nothing. The watches stayed whole: a heartbeat hears a stopped poller in about four minutes, the routine watch is stamped every five minutes, and a bell down for half an hour is told. Codex caught two real latency bugs, both fixed with tests.
left: The live bell on home is unchecked: this session holds no home token, so the owner checks after the next deploy that the bell connects and a routine put shows a ring pass within seconds.
The assurance ledger's wording and the calls C60 to C64 go in a some-ui pull request that opens after this one merged, because the wording is only true from then.
